title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing grant and scope validation to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. The flaw allows an attacker with valid credentials for one client to obtain tokens with the privileges of another client if the application validator authorizes based on the attacker-supplied client_id argument. The issue is fixed in OAuthlib version 0.21.0_1.
